projectTitle: COLOSSEUM OF ASH — IGNIS_REX vs LEVIATHAN_SPINO (V3 SceneBuilder-First Zero-Hitch Master)
architecture: SceneBuilder-First Continuous Filmmaking (6 Seed Clusters + 9 In-Scene Omni 1.2 Flash Extends <= 26s/cluster)

screenDirectionLock.IGNIS_REX: Screen-Left facing Right (Charcoal-black osteoderm scales, glowing volcanic crimson chest scars)
screenDirectionLock.LEVIATHAN_SPINO: Screen-Right facing Left (Slate-grey crocodilian armor, towering 2.5m bioluminescent cyan dorsal sail)

clusters.act: Act I — The Arena & Arrival of IGNIS_REX

extends.prompt: Continuing seamlessly from the previous frame with zero velocity drop, IGNIS_REX on the Left side of the frame (13-meter apex Tyrannosaurus Rex with charcoal-black osteoderm armor and glowing volcanic crimson magma chest scars) finishes its earth-shattering roar and stomps forward across the rain-slicked black basalt Colosseum floor, jaws snapping shut with a heavy bone-ratchet clack as steam vents from its nostrils. The 35mm anamorphic camera tracks backward at a low 15-degree angle with heavy hydraulic footstep tremor, keeping IGNIS_REX locked on the Left facing Right as lightning illuminates the tiered stone arches and rusted iron portcullis gates. Deep sub-bass footstep impacts, hissing volcanic steam on wet stone, and crackling braziers, no music, no human voices, no text or HUD.

clusters.act: Act I — Arrival of LEVIATHAN_SPINO & Standoff

extends.prompt: Continuing seamlessly from the previous frame with zero velocity drop, LEVIATHAN_SPINO on the Right side of the frame (15-meter aquatic-armored Spinosaurus with slate-grey crocodilian scutes, elongated gharial snout, and towering 2.5-meter dorsal neural sail pulsing with bioluminescent cyan veins) plants its massive hooked foreclaws into the flooded basalt puddles facing Left, arches its neck, and unleashes a rattling amphibious bellow across the arena toward IGNIS_REX on the Left. The 50mm anamorphic lens performs a tense lateral dolly-arc from Right to Center, capturing cyan bioluminescent reflections rippling across the black water and volcanic ash. Deep guttural amphibious resonance, water splashes, and thunderous storm wind, no music, no human voices, no text or HUD.

Continuing seamlessly from the full-momentum collision in the previous frame, IGNIS_REX on the Left (charcoal-black T-Rex with glowing crimson magma scars) and LEVIATHAN_SPINO on the Right (slate-grey Spinosaurus with glowing cyan dorsal sail) lock jaws and shoulders at the center of the wet basalt arena, their 20-ton bodies grinding together as shockwaves of rainwater and volcanic sparks erupt outward. The 35mm anamorphic camera pushes in dynamically with handheld kinetic impact shake as IGNIS_REX's crushing jaws clamp onto the side of LEVIATHAN_SPINO's elongated snout, spraying saliva and embers. Crushing bone impact, grinding scales, and roaring monster vocalizations, no music, no human voices, no text or HUD.

Continuing seamlessly from the jaw-lock grapple with zero hitch, LEVIATHAN_SPINO on the Right violently wrenches its head free and drives its massive muscular shoulder and glowing cyan sail forward, shoving IGNIS_REX backward across the wet black basalt flagstones so its hind claws gouge deep sparks and water plumes into the stone. The camera tracks laterally alongside the sliding titans at knee height, preserving the 180-degree axis with IGNIS_REX on the Left and LEVIATHAN_SPINO on the Right under flashing crimson and cyan lighting. Heavy skidding stone friction, guttural snarls, and torrential rain, no music, no human voices, no text or HUD.

clusters.act: Act II-A — Spino Hydro-Claw Dominance & Pillar Crash

extends.prompt: Continuing seamlessly from the claw slash in the previous frame, LEVIATHAN_SPINO on the Right follows through with a devastating second hooked foreclaw strike and whip-like tail sweep that slams IGNIS_REX on the Left straight into a massive Corinthian basalt pillar, shattering the ancient stone column into falling boulders and clouds of wet ash as IGNIS_REX crashes onto its side in the mud. The 28mm wide anamorphic camera whip-pans slightly with the impact and drops to ground level as rubble rains down around both titans. Thunderous stone pillar collapse, razor claw rip, and painful monster roar, no music, no human voices, no text or HUD.

clusters.act: Act II-B — All Is Lost, Crimson Overdrive & Neck-Break Counter

extends.prompt: Continuing seamlessly from the pinned struggle in the previous frame, IGNIS_REX on the Left ignites in blinding volcanic crimson overdrive—its sub-dermal magma scars flaring white-hot and boiling the rainwater around its body into explosive steam—and surges upward from the basalt floor, slamming its armored skull into LEVIATHAN_SPINO's chest on the Right to break the pin. The 35mm anamorphic camera rises rapidly with IGNIS_REX's explosive counter-surge, illuminated by intense crimson embers clashing against cyan bioluminescence. Roaring geothermal steam explosion, cracking armor plates, and furious apex roar, no music, no human voices, no text or HUD.

Continuing seamlessly from the crimson counter-surge with zero velocity drop, IGNIS_REX on the Left lunges forward with blazing magma jaws wide open and clamps its 6-ton bite directly onto the base of LEVIATHAN_SPINO's neck and dorsal sail on the Right, lifting and violently thrashing the 15-meter Spinosaurus off balance across the shattered arena stones. Tight 50mm kinetic tracking shot following the brutal jaw-clamp and thrash, sparks and cyan droplets flying through the storm. Bone-crushing jaw snap, agonizing reptilian screech, and heavy thrashing footsteps, no music, no human voices, no text or HUD.

clusters.act: Act III — Seismic Finisher Slam & Alpha Victory Roar

extends.prompt: Continuing seamlessly from the seismic body slam in the previous frame, LEVIATHAN_SPINO lies defeated and motionless on the cracked basalt arena floor on the Right as its cyan dorsal sail flickers and dims, while IGNIS_REX on the Left plants its massive clawed hind foot firmly onto the fallen rival's flank amidst rising volcanic steam and settling rubble. The 35mm anamorphic camera cranes slowly upward from the cracked crater floor toward IGNIS_REX's towering silhouette. Rumbling aftershock stone settling, heavy victorious breathing, and hissing rain, no music, no human voices, no text or HUD.

Continuing seamlessly from the previous frame, IGNIS_REX stands victorious atop the defeated LEVIATHAN_SPINO in the center of the Colosseum of Ash, throws its scarred charcoal-black head skyward as crimson magma veins pulse brightly across its neck and chest, and unleashes a triumphant, prolonged alpha roar as forked lightning splits the storm clouds overhead and the camera executes a majestic slow pull-back. Earth-shaking alpha Tyrannosaurus roar echoing across the stone amphitheater, thunderclap, and pouring rain, no music, no human voices, no text or HUD.
